name: Cape Town
tagline: Mountain, ocean and a spectacular peninsula
summary: Give Table Mountain a flexible weather window and dedicate a day to the peninsula. Museums, gardens and food make useful alternatives when wind closes exposed attractions.
seasonNote: Summer is popular but wind can disrupt the cableway and boats; winter rain changes hiking plans.
arrival: Arrange a reputable airport transfer or ride and allow for peak-hour roads.
gettingAround: Use reputable rides or a rental car for dispersed sights; check current local advice before walking unfamiliar areas.
cashTip: Cards are common; keep modest ZAR cash for small purchases and tips.
foodTip: Try Cape Malay dishes, fresh seafood and local produce; book sought-after restaurants.
buyTip: Browse locally designed crafts and textiles; inspect provenance and shipping arrangements.
